comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: Not really. Any quests that are part of a chain quest are usually not repeatable. Only exception is if you lose the discovery card for it through debate, treasure hunt, or if you make it into an ornament. THEN you can re-take the quest again to get the card. Also note that you usually wont get the weapon again if it drops one, or at least it has an extremely low drop probability.
